edges.reason: constructor takes msg.sender and uses it as the initial owner
untrusted msg.sender value is written into the owner state variable
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before setOwner can execute
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before addOrChangePair can execute
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before addOrChangePairBulk can execute
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before removePair can execute
setOwner reaches the privileged owner = _owner assignment guarded only by onlyOwner
the privileged assignment overwrites the owner state variable that gates all other functions
_owner parameter is the value written to the privileged owner slot
addOrChangePair performs the mapping write operation
the write targets the pairs state mapping
_from is used as the outer mapping key
_to is used as the inner mapping key
_contract is the value stored in the pair mapping
addOrChangePairBulk executes the in-loop mapping write
the bulk write targets the pairs state mapping
_fromList supplies the outer keys for the bulk write
_toList supplies the inner keys for the bulk write
_contractList supplies the values stored by the bulk write and bounds iteration
loop counter i indexes the arrays and drives the repeated state write
the for-loop in addOrChangePairBulk initializes and increments the i local variable
removePair performs the delete on the pair mapping
the delete targets the pairs state mapping
_from identifies the outer key being deleted
_to identifies the inner key being deleted
getPair reads from the pairs state mapping
_from is used as the outer read key in getPair
_to is used as the inner read key in getPair
